headline: AI/ML and Backend Engineer
summary: Computer Engineering student at the University of Dubai on a full scholarship, building applied AI and computer vision tools, backend systems and full-stack web apps for clinics, classrooms and small businesses.

hakim-click.description: Clinical answers drawn from Ethiopia's national treatment guidelines.
hakim-click.highlight: 38 guidelines and 13,536 passages, embedded and searched with pgvector.

yakal.description: Tutoring and college counselling, with Stripe checkout and Zoom lessons.

ud-students.description: NFC and BLE enabled student ID carried on the phone.

clixa-tools.description: Exposes 63 clinical calculators as tools the assistant calls instead of hallucinating.

visionaid.description: A phone assistant that reads, recognizes and warns for visually impaired users.
visionaid.highlight: Built for the 19th IEEE Student Day competition.

drone-hunter.description: A simulated drone that finds and chases a moving rover using only its camera.
drone-hunter.highlight: Keeps the rover in view about 87% of the time.

avatar-kit.description: Cartoon avatars in the browser that copy your face and lip sync to your voice.
avatar-kit.highlight: MediaPipe tracks head, eyes and mouth; a Verlet solver moves the hair and body.

signspeak.description: Learn American Sign Language with your webcam as the marker.
signspeak.highlight: Hand tracking and classification both run in the browser, with no server.

yamnet-cough.description: Tells bronchial, asthma, COPD, pneumonia and healthy lungs apart from a cough.
yamnet-cough.highlight: Reaches 87% accuracy with transfer learning on YAMNet embeddings.

manim-generator.description: Describe a math animation in plain language and get a rendered video.
manim-generator.highlight: Exposed as an MCP server, so an assistant can render animations as a tool.

uae-companies.description: A scraped directory of UAE employers for students, mapped on OpenStreetMap.
